about_the_game:
A cleaning job usually ends quietly.
This one doesn’t.

In MISADDRESSED, you’re a young cleaner taking late-night gigs to make money. A phone call sends you to an apartment building. You step inside and get to work: rooms, stains, small details… Everything feels “normal” until exhaustion creeps in and you doze off.

Then you hear a sound.

When you wake up, you’re not in the same place, or you think you are. The phone rings again. The caller says, “You didn’t clean my home.” And that’s when it hits you: you’re in the wrong apartment. Now, when you try to leave, the door won’t open.

This is psychological horror that builds tension rather than relying on high-speed chases. The building’s silence, the tiny irregularities inside the flat, and the relentless phone calls all corner you into one question: How do you get out?

In a single-sitting experience of about an hour, you’ll explore your surroundings, notice what you missed while cleaning, follow sounds, and feel the line between reality and perception start to thin. You didn’t make a wrong move. You walked through the wrong door. And now that mistake is locked in with you.

  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 / AMD Radeon RX 560
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

  • OS: Windows 10/11

  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
